input.title: Aventon Aventure 3
input.descriptionHtml:
New Aventon Aventure 3 fat tire ebike Step Over & Step-Through in stock. 750W hub motor, 4\" puncture-resistant tires, suspension fork & seatpost, rack, fenders & kickstand included. $1,999 + $160 as

Aventon Aventure 3
750W Fat Tire Ebike

 

The Aventon Aventure 3 is a purpose-built all-terrain fat tire ebike designed to handle whatever you point it at pavement, gravel, dirt trails, sand, and snow. A 750W rear hub motor with 80Nm of torque delivers strong, confident power across all terrain types, with Boost Mode providing up to 1,440W peak power in 30-second bursts for steep climbs or heavy starts. The 26"x4.0" Inova puncture-resistant fat tires paired with an 80mm travel suspension fork and a 50mm travel suspension seatpost absorb trail chop and rough surfaces, keeping the ride planted and comfortable. Both the Step Over and Step-Through frames are in stock at Quest Watersports in Ottawa, IL, each available in Regular and Large sizing.

The Aventure 3 runs on Aventon's ACU connected platform, delivering 4G/GPS tracking, an integrated rear wheel e-lock, motion detection and alarm, geofencing, remote shutdown, and Apple Watch connectivity managed through the Aventon app with over-the-air firmware updates. Sensor Switch lets you toggle between torque and cadence sensing depending on how you want the assist to feel. Cruise Control, Ride Tune customization, and Hold Mode complete the feature set. The cross-model keyless battery is compatible with the Abound SR, Abound LR, Level 3, and Pace 4. Note: 4G connectivity is complimentary for the first year; a paid subscription is required after that period.

**E-Bikes are subject to a $160 assembly & tuning fee** 

Frame styles & fit:

  • Step Over Matcha or Stealth Regular (5'3" - 5'10") / Large (5'10" - 6'4") 76 lbs
  • Step-Through Java or Cobalt Blue Regular (4'11" - 5'7") / Large (5'7" - 6'1") 77 lbs
 

Included with every Aventure 3:

  • Rear rack (integrated)
  • Full fenders, front and rear (integrated)
  • Kickstand (rear mount)
  • Integrated front and rear lights
  • Throttle (left handlebar mounted)
  • Suspension seatpost (50mm travel)
  • 9/16" alloy platform pedals
  • 42V 4A charger

Specs:
Motor 36V, 750W Rear Hub (1,440W Peak in Boost Mode)
Motor Torque 80Nm
Battery 36V, 20Ah, 733Wh Removable Internal, LG 21700 cells
Range Up to 65 miles (est.)
Charge Time 5 hours (0 - 100%)
Pedal Assist 3 Levels + Boost Mode with Ride Tune Customization
Display Aventon BC280
Frame 6061 Aluminum, Gravity Cast Front Triangle
Fork Aventon/Zoom Suspension, 80mm Travel, Lockout
Seatpost Aventon Suspension Seatpost, 30.9mm, 50mm Travel
Tires Inova 26" x 4.0" Puncture Resistant
Brakes Tektro HD-E3520 Hydraulic Disc, 180mm rotors, front & rear
Drivetrain Shimano Altus 8-Speed, 1232T Cassette, 48T Chainring, 170mm Crank
Sensors Double-Sided Bottom Bracket Torque Sensor
Smart Features 4G/GPS, E-Lock, Motion Alarm, Geofencing, Remote Shutdown, Sensor Switch, Cruise Control, Boost Mode, Ride Tune, Hold Mode, Apple Watch, OTA Updates
Battery Compatibility Cross-compatible with Abound SR, Abound LR, Level 3, Pace 4
Ebike Class Class 2 (Convertible to Class 1 or 3)
Step Over Colors Matcha, Stealth
Step-Through Colors Java, Cobalt Blue
Step Over Fit Regular 5'3" - 5'10" / Large 5'10" - 6'4"
Step-Through Fit Regular 4'11" - 5'7" / Large 5'7" - 6'1"
Weight 76 lbs (Step Over) / 77 lbs (Step-Through)
Weight Capacity 400 lbs
Water Resistance IPX5 (bike) / IPX6 (components)
Safety Cert. UL 2849 Certified
Price $1,999 + $160 assembly & tuning ($2,159 total)


Come see them in person. Both frame styles are regularly on the floor at Quest Watersports
**Call or email to confirm specific availability**
